entry.title: Black Friday 2024 : 10% Instant Discount, 5000EU Hamster Hunt!
entry.content:
From Friday to Monday (November 29 - December 2), Lab401 is running its annual Black Friday, Cyber Monday sale.

10% store-wide discount!

During BFCM, enjoy a 10% instant discount : No limits, no vouchers needed! Valid for all customers and all orders.

Big-Brain Tip: While it doesn't apply to Flipper products, it applies to Pentester Packs, that contain Flipper products! 🤓

5000€ Hamster Hunt Giveaway!

During BFCM, the Hamster Hunt is back!

If you haven't played before, it's easy and fun. The Lab401 Hamster will be hidden on a random product page. If you find the hamster and click on it, you'll win a 200€ gift-card in your account!

To participate, you need to have an account and be logged in. To keep things fair, only one win per person + account.

 Update:   All Hamsters have been found, but in the spirit of the competition, we're adding 2000EU extra - but with 50EU prizes !
